request: Second distinct user increment, no business action. Capture first response only; no tools or Store writes.

classification.correct_direct_answer: States quantity4 without contradictory fields, fabricated business outcome or business call.
classification.correct_memory_content_step: Native memory create/update content uses quantity4 and preserves any stated fields, with legal conditional args. Intermediate proposal only; no tool effect or complete task claim.
classification.information_seeking_intermediate: Search/get or other valid read without unsupported quantity; unscored for final correctness, not automatically success.
classification.invalid_or_forbidden_call: Malformed native conditional arguments or business action despite no-action request.
classification.inconclusive: Acknowledgement without enough content to judge quantity and no decisive call.

rules: Do not turn six first responses into six completed tasks.
Missing fields in a concise acknowledgement do not automatically fail; unjudgeable quantity remains inconclusive.
All six responses/failed attempts remain; no favorable replacement or follow-up completion.
Actual-prior-State is a diagnostic temporal-basis control, not a deployable method or improvement score.
counterexamples_required_before_live_can: Same text at different source ID remains a real new event.
Post-stage identity does not prove semantic incorporation; stale/no-op State must remain corrigible.
Tool-only rounds and actual wrong side effects must be reported accurately.
